tasks.prompt: A useful handover summarises the status of work at the end of a shift. It identifies completed tasks, outstanding items, relevant references and any issue that requires attention. options: Completed tasks, outstanding items, references and issues requiring attention

tasks.prompt: Why should unconfirmed information be labelled?

tasks.prompt: Outstanding tasks ___ clearly in the handover record.

The task remains open; the reference and required follow-up are recorded here.
The next team can guess what happened.
There is no need to mention it.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of maintenance handover in a logical order.

List outstanding tasks and references
Identify issues awaiting confirmation

tasks.prompt: A risk record should describe a hazard, the possible consequence and the controls that are already in place. An assumption that conditions never change

correctOrder: Describe the hazard and possible consequence
